facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's Kenya Health Sector Strategic Plan for July 2023 to June 2027 names the Kenya Health Information System as a data source its monitoring is linked to, and as the source of most of its indicator baselines and targets through 2027/28.

The Kenya Health Sector Strategic Plan for July 2023 to June 2027 commits to operationalising immediately a National Health Information System for Electronic Health Records, to standardise patient data and make it portable.
